summary:
Here is a summary of the election committee's announcement regarding the results of the party-list Member of Parliament vote count for Constituency 1, Suphanburi Province:


General Election Information
Announcement Date: The announcement was made on February 8, B.E. 2569 (2026).
Election Day: The election was held on February 8, B.E. 2569 (2026).
Total Eligible Voters: 135,381 people.
Voters Who Showed Up: 102,476 people.
Total Ballots Allocated: 144,560 ballots.
Total Ballots Used: 98,442 ballots.
Total Ballots Used for Counting (Total Voter Turnout): 102,476 ballots.
Good Ballots: 93,897 ballots.
Invalid Ballots: 4,799 ballots.
Ballots not selecting any party list: 3,780 ballots.
Party-List Vote Results (Top 3 by Score)


The total score for all political parties was 93,897. The political parties with the highest scores were:
Bhumjaithai (No. 37): 39,992 votes.
Pheu Thai (No. 9): 6,073 votes.
Democrat (No. 27): 2,771 votes.
